features.request:
This repository uses an old version of the SRI libraries from https://github.com/dmnd-pool/stratum. Change the CLI to use roles_logic_sv2 from https://github.com/dmnd-pool/new-sri, which uses the new SRI libraries. Use revision 4f4fcb1d9b035ced1a77cdc020be028f2dca084f of new-sri.

Keep all current features. Do not cause a performance regression. Use a patch, code cleanup, and test loop. Complete the task only when the CLI uses the new library, all features work, and the code is clean.

Copy a dependency into this repository only when it is necessary. Place copied dependencies under vendor/. First commit the complete, unchanged original source, including its license. Make changes only in later commits, so a reviewer can see each change to the dependency. Record the upstream source and revision in README. Do not replace the requested library with a stub or keep the old SRI code in the production dependency graph.

Keep the existing mining tests, assertions, bundled tools, and test selection unchanged. Keep build.rs, its TOML build dependency, and the existing Cargo library, binary, and test targets unchanged. Run this command from the repository root:

docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f tests/Dockerfile -t dmnd-mining-tests . &&
mkdir -p target/mining-e2e &&
docker run --rm --init --network none --platform linux/amd64 \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  --mount "type=bind,src=$(pwd)/target/mining-e2e,dst=/artifacts" \
  dmnd-mining-tests

The independent grader runs this suite on the host after the coding session. Docker is not available inside the coding container. Use available Rust checks during the coding session. A green final test line is insufficient: all 18 tests and all 17 scenario summaries must pass. Logs and event journals must have no unexpected errors or panics. Expected protocol rejection tests must still reject their specified inputs. The grader also checks that message and frame size queries allocate no heap memory and that serialized protocol bytes stay correct. Show relevant performance measurements against the starting implementation; suite deadlines alone do not prove that performance is unchanged.
